meta.name: Lambs of God
meta.description:
A dark, gothic tale about three nuns, each a generation apart, living in an isolated convent by the coast, and an unwelcome visitor who enters their lives and changes their world forever.

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

videos.title: The Devil into Paradise
videos.overview: The peaceful existence of three eccentric, secluded nuns living in a remote island monastery is shattered when a priest unwittingly happens upon them.

videos.title: The Blood of Eden
videos.overview: As Frankie launches a search for her missing brother, the nuns give Ignatius an ultimatum: wed himself to their order or face certain death.

videos.title: The Beast Incarnate
videos.overview: A lifetime of lies drives a wedge between Carla and her sisters. Iphigenia is forced to face her past in order to save her home, and Ignatius must decide where his loyalties lie.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: As a memorial is held for Ignatius on the mainland, Father Bob arrives on the island to annihilate the Sisters of St. Agnes. Iphigenia's loyalty is tested when she considers a deal with the devil to save the monastery. Series finale.
